description:
Welcome to the Bella Charca Community in Nolanville, TX, located near Fort Hood! In this video, we tour the stunning Frio model home by Flintrock Builders. This exquisite home features an elegant design, top-notch finishes, and an open-concept layout, perfect for modern living.

NOTE:  This is the MODEL HOME, so there are upgrades and possible premium lot pricing on this particular property. If you are interested in a preview or want up-to-date availability of this or any other plan with Flintrock, call or text me today at 254-833-7663. I work closely with this builder and will be happy to provide all the most current information!

🔔 Don't forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more home tours and community highlights. Hit the bell icon to stay updated with my latest videos!
